notes.title: Expedition: Into Darkness finally announced!
notes.content:
We've finally revealed our announcement trailer! Dive into the world we've crafted and get a glimpse of the adventure that awaits you. Watch the trailer right here:

[previewyoutube=H3s21JcNKco;full][/previewyoutube]

But that’s just the beginning! To stay updated on all the latest news and exclusive content, don’t forget to:

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126410/Expedition_Into_Darkness/]Wishlist us here on Steam[/url]
